recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source matches the accepted link-direction decision, and no additional source edit is needed for FHIR-31859.
issue_request: FHIR-31859 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request resolved as Persuasive for R5. It said MedicinalProductDefinition could not point to PackagedProductDefinition because bidirectional product/package links were inappropriate where many products point to fewer packages, and its resolution was to remove the bidirectional links.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in source history. Commit 700d56df5d changed MedicinalProductDefinition.packagedMedicinalProduct from a CodeableReference targeting PackagedProductDefinition to a CodeableConcept, and commit aa2f228c82 removed MedicinalProductDefinition.package.package Reference(PackagedProductDefinition) while updating examples so packages point back to products.
additional_context: MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition are active current-build resources. Later FHIR-31776 work renamed the package-side relationship from subject to packageFor, FHIR-31782 removed the obsolete MedicinalProductDefinition.package backbone, and a combined-branch FHIR-31863 reconciliation fixed stale productFor narrative references to packageFor.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current MedicinalProductDefinition.packagedMedicinalProduct is only a CodeableConcept and current MedicinalProductDefinition has no Reference targetProfile to PackagedProductDefinition; current PackagedProductDefinition.packageFor is the active Reference to MedicinalProductDefinition.
